Security and Privacy

How do I protect sensitive information?

Short Answer

Use approved systems and sharing settings, limit access to people who need it, and follow agency classification, storage and handling requirements.

Detailed Guidance

Identify the sensitivity and classification of the information before storing, emailing or sharing it. Use only approved systems, check recipients and access permissions, minimise the information included, and follow your agency's procedures if information is exposed or sent to the wrong person.
